shared_elements: round head element atop a body
linear/geometric abstraction of the human form
justification: Both depict a highly schematic upright anthropomorphic figure with a rounded head above a body and legs, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A shows a three-dimensional stacked, blocky composition of a hunched figure supporting a large oval mass with incised facial/feather-like detail, while B is a flat outline stick-figure whose head is a wheel/cross-in-circle, set beneath a horizontal comb-toothed band elattific attributes shared beyond the bare human silhouette.
